summary: Coordination board for the Blue, Red, Green, and Overwatch agents building the repo-to-ship Unity MVP.

columns.label: Backlog

columns.label: Review

actors.label: QuestKeeper
actors.role: Consolidated audit and board coverage agent.

actors.label: Overwatch
actors.role: Protocol tracker, integration watcher, and append-only recorder.

actors.label: Blue
actors.role: Node truth, repo metrics, fleet manifest, provenance.

actors.label: Green
actors.role: Interaction, phone-ready controls, demo loop, QA.

actors.label: Human
actors.role: Project owner, reviewer, priority setter, canon authority.

actors.label: Red
actors.role: Unity scene, kit-backed ships, orbit world, visual integration.

protocol.recordRule: Every board change, communication, block, checkpoint, and telemetry observation is appended as an event. The board is derived from the event log.
protocol.safeActionPolicy: The MVP tracker may record work proposals and coordination events, but it must not perform destructive repo or Unity operations.
